name: Shielda CAPTCHA
author: mojtabaghasemi

sections.description:
Shielda is a modern, next-generation CAPTCHA and bot detection service designed to protect websites and web applications from credential stuffing, spam submissions, and malicious automated bot traffic while delivering a delightful, friction-free user experience for genuine human visitors.

With the Shielda CAPTCHA WordPress plugin, you can secure every critical entry point on your website in just a few clicks—no coding or template modification required.

Key Features

  • WordPress Login & Registration: Stops automated brute-force attacks, password guessing, and fake account creation.
  • WordPress Comments: Eliminates automated comment spam and trackback abuse.
  • WordPress Lost Password: Blocks password reset flooding attacks.
  • Full WooCommerce Integration: Out-of-the-box support for WooCommerce Login, Register, Lost Password, and Checkout forms.
  • WPForms Compatibility: Seamless integration with both WPForms Lite and WPForms Pro contact forms.
  • Ultra-Fast & Reliable: Powered by dedicated high-speed edge infrastructure with sub-millisecond response times.
  • Cryptographically Secure: Server-to-server token verification (/api/v1/siteverify) ensures tokens cannot be spoofed or replayed.
  • Privacy-Friendly: Zero intrusive cross-site tracking and fully compliant with privacy standards.
  • Responsive & Mobile-Ready: Interactive puzzle and image challenge widgets adapt smoothly to phones, tablets, and desktops.

sections.installation:
Automatic Installation (Recommended)

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  3. Search for Shielda CAPTCHA.
  4. Click Install Now, then click Activate.

Manual Installation (ZIP Upload)

  1. Download shielda-captcha.zip from WordPress.org or directly from the Shielda Website.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin in your dashboard.
  3. Choose the ZIP file and click Install Now, then Activate.

Configuration

  1. Obtain your Site Key and Secret Key from your Shielda Dashboard.
  2. In your WordPress admin menu, go to Settings > Shielda CAPTCHA (or click the Shielda CAPTCHA sidebar menu).
  3. Paste your Site Key and Secret Key.
  4. Select the forms you want to protect (Login, Register, Comments, WooCommerce, WPForms) and click Save Changes.
sections.faq:
Where do I get my Site Key and Secret Key?

You can register an account and generate keys for your domains for free on https://shielda.ir.

Does Shielda work with WooCommerce?

Yes! Shielda fully integrates with WooCommerce login, registration, lost password, and checkout forms without requiring template edits.

Does it support WPForms?

Yes, Shielda automatically injects protection into forms created with both WPForms Lite and WPForms Pro.

Does Shielda comply with user privacy regulations?

Yes. Shielda does not track users across websites, does not sell user data, and complies with privacy protection principles.
